create_clip_image_text_embeddings: create CLIP embeddings from images and text to compute cross-modal similarity scores
compute_image_text_contrastive_loss: compute the bidirectional contrastive loss between image and text embeddings
run_image_classification: run image classification using CLIP vision encoder with a linear classification head
get_text_features_with_projection: get projected text embeddings from CLIP text model for downstream tasks
get_image_features_with_projection: get projected image embeddings from CLIP vision model for downstream tasks
